representation: Canonical bounded JSON with exact typed ArtifactIds; assertions remain untrusted until fresh consumer-selected checker replay.
requiredBindings: evidence class and exact evidence identities
assuredRelease: Derived only from a caller-pinned nonempty psc-claim-policy/1 exact conjunction. Raw AssuredRelease assertions reject. Policy satisfaction is audit data and does not mint a release capability.
noImplications: Integrity verification does not establish any semantic claim
validation: scripts/claim-set.test.mjs; scripts/backend-contract.test.mjs; scripts/observed-build-context.test.mjs. Fixture checkers validate infrastructure behavior only; fresh cloud validation pending.
remaining: Built-in offline CLI checker registry and real evidence producers
Pinned real checker adapters for each supported claim
AuthorityBroker isolation and complete influence closure
Assured release policy and real evidence campaigns

consumerIntegration.selection: Caller supplies claimVerification.checkers and allowedAssumptions, plus optional exact claimPolicy artifact. Policy requires explicit verification configuration.
consumerIntegration.snapshot: Shared capture validates and copies selected checker map, assumptions and bounded canonical policy bytes before any resolver/checker callback.
consumerIntegration.enforcement: Every assertion is freshly checked under selected implementations; optional nonempty exact conjunction must be satisfied. Missing V5 context, unavailable checkers, denied assumptions and unsatisfied requirements reject.
consumerIntegration.output: Exact scoped verification and optional policy decision are reported in the bundle result; archive global semanticClaimsVerified, preservationVerified and releaseAccepted remain false.
consumerIntegration.default: Producer ClaimSet remains empty until actual evidence exists. Omitted claim verification preserves historical integrity-only reading; archive data never installs checker code or policy.
